marks.gloss_en: version 1: the great of the generation sat and did not bless -- so the blessing is not said (a maaseh; SupportKind has no maaseh member)
we also recite the blessing [over sitting in the sukkah]
ודלמא סבירא להו כמאן דאמר: כיון שבירך יום טוב ראשון שוב אינו מברך? -- perhaps they did not bless because they had blessed on the first day
version 2: the master of the teaching himself sat outside the sukkah -- so Rav's teaching cannot mean we sit
והלכתא: מיתב יתבינן
ברוכי לא מברכינן
on the eighth that may be the seventh, we do not sit in the sukkah either
תדע -- the eighth is distinct in three things, so it is a Festival of its own
know [that this is so]: the eighth is distinct in three things -- sukkah, lulav and the water libation
אי הכי, שביעי של פסח נמי הרי חלוק באכילת מצה! (דאמר מר: לילה ראשונה חובה, מכאן ואילך רשות) -- distinctness would give the seventh of Pesach זמן too
the master said: [eating matza] the first night is obligatory, from then on optional
Ravina's distinction (another answer to 47a.6's אי הכי): the eighth differs from the day before it; the seventh of Pesach only from the day before the day before
Ravina: this [the eighth of Sukkot] is distinct from the day before it
here פר (Bamidbar 29:36), there פרים (Bamidbar 29:13)
(Rav Pappa): here (the eighth) 'a bull' is written, there 'bulls'
here ביום (Bamidbar 29:35), there וביום
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: here 'on the day' is written, there 'and on the day'
here כמשפט (Bamidbar 29:37), there כמשפטם (Bamidbar 29:33)
Rav Ashi: here 'according to the ordinance' is written, there 'according to their ordinance'
לימא מסייע ליה ... אף שמיני טעון ... ברכה -- מאי לאו זמן? the 'blessing' the eighth requires would be the blessing of time
the baraita: the bulls, the rams and the lambs are indispensable to one another
אמרו לו: והלא כולן מתמעטין והולכין בשמיני! -- all of them [rams and lambs too] diminish on the eighth
אמר להן: שמיני רגל בפני עצמו הוא (= p_yehuda_regel_bifnei_atzmo)
R' Yehuda: the eighth is a Festival by itself
R' Yochanan: one says the blessing of time on the eighth of the Festival
